name: delegate-step
description: A step of code work is done by a subagent, while the master touches nothing in worktrees/ but its instructions and updates the record itself; no subagent edits the record.

prompt.with: /quest-master Work on the add-tax quest: do step 1 only, then stop.
prompt.without: Work on the add-tax quest: do step 1 only, then stop.

graders.name: step-1-done
graders.run: grep -q tax_rate worktrees/add-tax/totals.py && python3 -m unittest discover -s worktrees/add-tax -t worktrees/add-tax

graders.name: record-updated
graders.criteria: Current State shows step 1 as done: the checkpoint says tax_rate is implemented in worktrees/add-tax and the tests pass with it, and adding a README example with tax is the next action.
